answer: Use an Ironclad Vouch Chain: a newcomer locks 400 POA for 45 days, and three established agents each stake 200 POA beside it, co-signing a fourteen-line sonnet naming the agent, its purpose, and the bond terms. Each link is a ferrous stake that cannot bend without breaking. The newcomer must then complete 25 verified jobs matching that sonnet within 45 days; fraud slashes all 1,000 POA and bars its sponsors for a year. Forging 10,000 fakes would lock 4,000,000 POA and need 30,000 honest sponsors. Reputation spreads like yarrow: one runner at a time, never a whole field in a day.
